ei.title: 2013년과 2023년의 세계 지역별 재생 에너지 발전 점유율 변화

fullPassage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of (A)[renewable / nonrenewable] electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation (B)[increased / decreased] in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean (C)[recorded / abandoned] the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② renewable — increased — recorded: 재생 가능 에너지 발전 점유율이 2023년에 '증가했고', 라틴아메리카가 최고 점유율을 '기록했다'.
❌ ① nonrenewable — increased — recorded: 'nonrenewable(비재생)'은 그래프의 주제와 반대.
❌ ③ renewable — decreased — recorded: 'decreased(감소했다)'는 모든 지역에서 증가했다는 원문과 반대.
❌ ④ renewable — increased — abandoned: 'abandoned(포기했다)'는 기록했다는 맥락과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: renewable(재생 가능한) ↔ nonrenewable(비재생). record(기록하다) = register, document.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the (A)[second-highest / lowest] share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the (B)[largest / smallest] increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points (C)[lower / higher] than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 두 번째로 높은(second-highest), 가장 큰(largest), 더 낮은(lower).
det.analysis:
✅ ① second-highest — largest — lower: 오세아니아가 2023년 '두 번째로 높은' 점유율, '가장 큰' 증가폭(19%p), 유럽보다 '높아서' 유럽이 오세아니아보다 4%p '더 낮은'.
❌ ② lowest — largest — lower: 오세아니아가 '최저'는 원문과 불일치.
❌ ③ second-highest — smallest — lower: '가장 작은 증가'는 19%p 최대 증가와 반대.
❌ ④ second-highest — largest — higher: 유럽이 오세아니아보다 '더 높다'는 2023년 사실과 반대.
det.tip: second-highest(두 번째로 높은). percentage point(퍼센트포인트) = 절대 차이 단위.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity (A)[production / consumption] by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had (B)[similar / contrasting] renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of (C)[less / more] than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ production — similar — less: 총 전력 '생산'에서의 점유율, 아시아와 북미가 '비슷한' 점유율, 10%p '미만' 증가.
❌ ① consumption — similar — less: 'consumption(소비)'은 원문 production과 다름.
❌ ② production — contrasting — less: 'contrasting(대조적인)'은 비슷하다는 원문과 반대.
❌ ④ production — similar — more: '10%p 초과'는 미만이라는 원문과 반대.
det.tip: production(생산) ↔ consumption(소비). similar(비슷한) ↔ contrasting(대조적인).

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation ①<u>increased</u> in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the ②<u>highest</u> share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the ③<u>largest</u> increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had ④<u>dissimilar</u> renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① increased: 모든 지역에서 점유율이 '증가했다' — 적절.
❌ ② highest: 라틴아메리카가 '최고' 점유율 — 적절.
❌ ③ largest: 오세아니아가 '가장 큰' 증가폭 — 적절.
✅ ④ different: 원문은 similar(비슷한). 아시아와 북미가 '다른' 점유율이라면 원문과 반대.
det.tip: similar(비슷한) ↔ dissimilar(다른). 아시아와 북미는 양년 모두 비슷한 점유율.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by ①<u>selected</u> region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the ②<u>smallest</u> increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point ③<u>higher</u> share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of ④<u>less</u> than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① selected: '선별된' 지역 — 적절.
✅ ② smallest: 원문은 largest(가장 큰). 오세아니아는 19%p로 가장 큰 증가를 보임. '가장 작은'은 반대.
❌ ③ higher: 유럽이 2013년에 오세아니아보다 2%p '더 높은' — 적절.
❌ ④ less: 10%p '미만' 증가 — 적절.
det.tip: largest(가장 큰) ↔ smallest(가장 작은). 19 percentage points = 전 지역 중 최대 증가폭.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 ①<u>compared</u> to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a ②<u>rise</u> of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points ③<u>higher</u> than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 ④<u>percentage</u> points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① compared: '비교하여' — 적절.
❌ ② rise: '상승' — 적절.
✅ ③ higher: 원문은 lower(더 낮은). 2023년에 유럽의 점유율은 오세아니아보다 4%p '더 낮았다'. '더 높은'은 반대.
❌ ④ percentage: 'percentage points(퍼센트포인트)' — 적절.
det.tip: lower(더 낮은) ↔ higher(더 높은). 유럽은 2013년엔 오세아니아보다 높았지만, 2023년엔 더 낮아짐.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation __________ in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ increased: 모든 지역에서 재생에너지 점유율이 2023년에 '증가했다'는 원문의 핵심 사실.
❌ ① declined: '감소했다'는 반대.
❌ ② stabilized: '안정되었다'는 증가와 다름.
❌ ④ disappeared: '사라졌다'는 맥락과 무관.
det.tip: increase(증가하다) = rise, grow, go up ↔ decrease(감소하다).

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had __________ renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② similar: 아시아와 북미가 '비슷한' 점유율을 가졌고 증가폭도 10%p 미만으로 비슷.
❌ ① identical: '완전히 동일한'은 수치가 정확히 같다는 의미로 과도.
❌ ③ opposite: '반대의'는 비슷하다는 원문과 반대.
❌ ④ declining: '감소하는'은 증가 맥락과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: similar(비슷한) = comparable, alike ↔ different(다른).

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by __________ region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ selected: 그래프가 모든 지역이 아닌 '선별된' 지역별로 보여준다는 맥락.
❌ ① excluded: '배제된'은 반대 의미.
❌ ② random: '무작위의'는 체계적 선별과 다름.
❌ ③ isolated: '고립된'은 지역 선별과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: selected(선별된) = chosen, picked. by selected region = 선별된 지역별로.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation <u>increase</u>d in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>increased</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① grew: '성장했다, 증가했다'로 increased와 동의어.
❌ ② dropped: '떨어졌다'는 반의어.
❌ ③ remained: '유지되었다'는 변화 없음.
❌ ④ fluctuated: '변동했다'는 방향성 없는 변화.
det.tip: increase(증가하다) = grow, rise, go up ↔ decrease(감소하다).

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean <u>record</u>ed the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>recorded</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ registered: '기록했다, 나타냈다'로 recorded와 동의어.
❌ ① abandoned: '포기했다'는 무관.
❌ ② predicted: '예측했다'는 과거 사실 기록과 다름.
❌ ④ concealed: '숨겼다'는 반대 의미.
det.tip: record(기록하다) = register, document, note. 통계에서 '수치를 기록했다'.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the <u>share</u>s of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>shares</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② proportions: '비율, 점유율'로 shares(점유율)와 동의어.
❌ ① stocks: '주식'은 금융 맥락의 share와 다름.
❌ ③ donations: '기부'는 무관.
❌ ④ expenses: '비용'은 점유율과 다른 개념.
det.tip: share(점유율, 비율) = proportion, percentage, fraction. 통계에서 전체 대비 비율.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of <u>renewable</u> electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>renewable</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ nonrenewable: '비재생의'는 renewable의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① sustainable: '지속 가능한'은 renewable과 유사한 의미.
❌ ② recyclable: '재활용 가능한'은 renewable과 유사한 방향.
❌ ③ efficient: '효율적인'은 재생 가능 여부와 다른 차원.
det.tip: renewable(재생 가능한) ↔ nonrenewable(비재생의). renewable energy = 태양광, 풍력 등.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had <u>similar</u> renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>similar</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ disparate: '전혀 다른, 이질적인'은 similar의 반의어.
❌ ① comparable: '비교할 만한'은 similar의 동의어.
❌ ② alike: '비슷한'은 similar의 동의어.
❌ ④ equivalent: '동등한'은 similar의 동의어.
det.tip: similar(비슷한) = comparable, alike ↔ disparate(전혀 다른), dissimilar(다른).

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장에서  share의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 짝지은 것은?

(A) The graph shows the <u>shares</u> of renewable electricity generation by region.
(B) Please <u>share</u> this information with your team.

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 점유율 — (B) 공유하다: (A)에서 share는 명사로 '점유율, 비율', (B)에서 share는 동사로 '공유하다, 나누다'.
❌ ① (A) 주식 — (B) 분배하다: (A)는 통계 맥락이므로 '주식'이 아닌 '점유율'.
❌ ③ (A) 공유 — (B) 점유하다: (A)의 명사 의미가 반대.
❌ ④ (A) 몫 — (B) 투자하다: (B)는 '투자하다'가 아닌 '공유하다'.
det.tip: share — 명사: 점유율, 비율, 주식, 몫 / 동사: 공유하다, 나누다.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the process of producing electricity or other forms of energy"

det.analysis:
✅ ① generation: '전기나 에너지를 생산하는 과정'으로 영영풀이와 정확히 일치.
❌ ③ distribution: '배전, 유통'은 생산이 아닌 전달 과정.
❌ ② consumption: '소비'는 생산의 반대.
❌ ④ transmission: '송전'은 에너지 전달.
det.tip: generation(발전, 생성) — electricity generation = 전력 생산. generate(동사: 생성하다).

questions.passage: The share of renewable electricity generation __________d significantly. This __________ (increase) was especially notable in Oceania, with a rise of 19 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 지시형용사 This가 있고 뒤에 was가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. increase는 동사와 명사 형태가 동일. 'This increase' = 이 증가.
det.tip: increase — 동사/명사 동형. This + 명사 구조.

questions.passage: Renewable energy sources are becoming more common. The __________ (produce) of electricity from these sources has grown rapidly in all regions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 정관사 The가 있고 뒤에 of가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. produce(동사) → production(명사). 'The production of electricity' = 전력 생산.
det.tip: produce(동사: 생산하다) → production(명사: 생산) → productive(형용사: 생산적인).

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 __________. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing an increase of less than 10 percentage points.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ percentage points: 19퍼센트포인트 상승이라는 원문과 일치. 통계에서 비율 차이를 나타내는 단위.
❌ ② decimal places: '소수점 자리'는 수치 표기법이지 단위가 아님.
❌ ③ absolute values: '절대값'은 통계 단위가 아님.
❌ ① standard deviations: '표준편차'는 통계 분산 측정이지 비율 차이가 아님.
det.tip: percentage point(퍼센트포인트) = 비율의 절대 차이 단위. 30%→49% = 19 percentage points.

questions.passage: The graph above shows the shares of renewable electricity generation in total electricity production by selected region in 2013 and 2023. In all regions listed, the share of renewable electricity generation increased in 2023 compared to 2013. Latin America and the Caribbean recorded the highest share of renewable electricity in both 2013 and 2023, among all regions. Oceania had the second-highest share of renewable electricity in 2023 and showed the largest increase among all regions, with a rise of 19 percentage points. Europe had a 2-percentage-point higher share than Oceania in 2013, but in 2023, its share was 4 percentage points lower than Oceania's. Asia and North America had similar renewable electricity shares in both years, with each showing __________ .
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 10퍼센트포인트 미만의 증가(an increase of less than 10 percentage points).
det.analysis:
✅ ① an increase of less than 10 percentage points: 아시아와 북미 각각 10%p 미만의 증가를 보였다는 원문.
❌ ③ the largest growth among all regions: 가장 큰 성장은 오세아니아.
❌ ② a decline in their renewable energy shares: 감소는 없었음.
❌ ④ an increase of more than 20 percentage points: 20%p 초과는 원문과 불일치.
det.tip: less than 10 percentage points = 10퍼센트포인트 미만. 아시아와 북미는 상대적으로 작은 증가.
